test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the longest serving Chief Minister of a state?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Pawan Kumar Chamling**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pawan Kumar Chamling served as the** Chief Minister of Sikkim** from December 12, 1994, to May 27, 2019, making him the longest-serving Chief Minister in India.
 
• His tenure lasted for over 24 years.
 
• He is the** founder of the Sikkim Democratic Front (SDF)**.
 
• Under his leadership, Sikkim saw significant development in various sectors including education, healthcare, and infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ****Lal Thanhawla:** Served as the Chief Minister of **Mizoram** for multiple terms. 

**Gegong Apang:** Served as the Chief Minister of **Arunachal Pradesh** for a total of 22 years.

**Jyoti Basu:** Served as the Chief Minister of** West Bengal from** 1977 to 2000, making him one of the longest-serving Chief Ministers, but his tenure was shorter than Chamling’s. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__****Padmaja Naidu **served as the **Governor of West Bengal for the longest period in Indian history.** She held the office from 1956 to 1967, serving for 11 years.

**Dr. Rajendra Prasad** is the longest-serving** President of India.** He served two terms from 1950 to 1962, totaling 12 years. He was the first President of India.

**Jawaharlal Nehru** is the longest-serving **Prime Minister of India.** He served from August 15, 1947, to May 27, 1964, for a total of 16 years and 286 days.
